premises.text: Cloud data centers are energy-intensive and strained by AI/media demand and chip shortages while billions of devices sit idle
premises.evidence_span: 12 billion devices sit idly in our pockets or on our desks

premises.text: ByteKnight software uses those devices for intensive tasks such as video encoding, generative AI, and 3D rendering
premises.evidence_span: harnesses the collective strength of everyday devices to tackle intensive tasks like video encoding, generative AI, and 3D rendering

premises.text: Device owners earn a majority revenue share up to a monthly per-device amount while customers get much cheaper, faster compute than cloud
premises.evidence_span: We share 70% of the revenue, and we allow you to earn up to $150 per month for each device that you provide

premises.text: The model reuses older devices and reduces energy waste versus traditional data centers
premises.evidence_span: breathing new life into older devices and reducing substantial energy wastage relative to traditional data centers

value.text: Fast distributed computing that is sustainable and equitable relative to centralized cloud
value.evidence_span: supporting fast, distributed computations and providing a sustainable, equitable way of computing

notes: Provider and customer economics merged into P3 as one two-sided commercial condition. Vision of a worldwide grid not separately coded. Partnership/beta traction excluded. Singletons D2/D3 retained.
